skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand credit policies and credit operations such as loans, leasing, discounting, guarantees, and factoring.
Understand the concept of equity capital, its role, calculation methods, and distinguish between components of equity capital and core capital.
Apply analytical indicators for bank operations management such as scale, structure, growth, revenue, costs, profitability ratios, and risk ratios.
Understand types of risks and risk management methods in commercial banking operations.
Analyze real-world cases involving risks in commercial banking operations.
